entry: Under the declared laboratory tasks, the prototype met the local response target in most sessions, while integrated task and feedback evidence identified comprehension and keyboard-navigation barriers that limit any broader accessibility claim.
Build-and-evaluate performance targets, quantitative task outcomes and qualitative explanations integrated through a predeclared joint display.

Illustrative values only: the worked dataset records the local response target in 14 of 16 task sessions, while feedback identifies ambiguous urgency labels and one keyboard-navigation barrier. The joint display shows that fast response does not imply accessible comprehension.
